pairs.difference: B has a pale glow halo around the whole whistle and deep red-black pools inside the window and mouth opening. A has a broad soft sheen on the body and gentle, even shadow turning on the barrel, with no halo.
pairs.fix: Remove the glow halo around the object. Keep the openings only slightly darker than the body. Use one broad soft highlight and a gentle form turn.

pairs.difference: A has a large glossy sheen on the bell and the tassels are chunky with a smooth, bright turn. B has a thinner, subtler turn on the horn and smaller, less glossy tassels.
pairs.fix: Tone down the glossy highlights on the bell. Give the brass a softer, narrower sheen and let the tassels fall into gentle shadow.

pairs.difference: B has a bright orange-red glow radiating behind the cup, hard white plastic highlights on the saucer rim and flower, and a crisp cast shadow. A has a calmer, darker background, soft shading on the white china and a soft shadow.
pairs.fix: Remove the glow behind the cup. Make the china highlights soft and broad, and make the cast shadow soft and dark.

pairs.difference: B has crisp specular dots on the apples, a hard violet cast shadow on the table, and bright, even lighting across the weave. A has smoother apple modeling, a gentle shadow gradient on the basket, and softer contact shadows.
pairs.fix: Use soft, subtle highlights on the apples and basket. Make the shadow side darker and the contact shadow soft.

pairs.difference: B has strongly saturated glossy orange staves with bright metal band edges, shiny rivet highlights, and a sharp cast shadow. A has mild wood grain, soft turning from light to shadow, and a tighter, softer ground shadow.
pairs.fix: Make the highlights on the staves and bands matte and broad. Make the rivets read as small, dull bumps and the shadow soft.

pairs.difference: A has glossy hot spots on the headlights and body, a bright blue rim along the roof and hood, and a purple bounce under the car. B has flatter, gentler shading with less sharp sheen.
pairs.fix: Reduce the bright gloss highlights and the blue edge glow. Use a soft, wide highlight on the hood and a gentle shadow gradient on the body.

pairs.difference: A has a strong glowing lantern, bright sun rays, and a vivid light-to-shadow contrast across the tent. B has an even, soft turn on the canvas and subdued light, with no hot glow.
pairs.fix: Remove the glow from the lantern and the sun-ray bloom. Keep the canvas shading soft and low in contrast.

pairs.difference: A has a strong fire glow that lights the stones and pot underside, a glossy rim on the pot and a very bright, saturated interior. B has softer, more even shading and a restrained glow under the pot.
pairs.fix: Reduce the fire glow on the stones and pot. Keep the pot matte with only a soft broad highlight.

pattern: Generated cards add glow and glare: a halo or bloom behind the hero, hard white specular dots on the plastic, a bright rim along the edges, and crisp saturated cast shadows. Real cards keep soft, broad, matte-leaning sheens and gentler, quieter lighting.
